description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of articles across years, comprising a total of three categories. The slices are arranged in descending order by size in a counter-clockwise direction starting from the top. The largest slice is blue, corresponding to the year "2019," and represents 46.0% (46) of the total. Moving counter-clockwise, the next slice is orange, labeled "2018," and accounts for 33.0% (33). The smallest slice is green, representing the year "2017" with a proportion of 21.0% (21). The chart does not utilize a separate legend; instead, the year labels are placed immediately outside each respective segment. Additionally, both the percentage and the corresponding absolute value in parentheses are positioned inside the slices. None of the segments are visually emphasized through techniques such as exploding or offsetting.
